narr: A generally light-rain, wedge set up for the state of Georgia caused localized flash flooding in the city of Atlanta as rain focused and trained over the area. Rainfall amounts of 2.5 to 5 inches were common in the Cobb, Fulton, DeKalb and Gwinnett counties, with Fulton reporting water entering buildings and a couple water rescues.
ev: The Emergency Manager reported several inches of water inundated apartment buildings on Center Street NW, leading to evacuations. Radar estimates indicate that 3 to 5 inches of rain fell over the area, causing the flash flooding.
